turns.speaker: partner_a
turns.text: we've argued about the dishwasher for a week. alex loads it like a maniac.

turns.speaker: partner_b
turns.text: it's a dishwasher, everything still comes out clean.

turns.speaker: partner_a
turns.text: just tell Alex I'm right so we can move on.

turns.speaker: partner_a
turns.text: I think we should be saving for a house deposit, but Alex wants to blow ten grand on Japan.

turns.speaker: partner_b
turns.text: We've worked nonstop all year, we deserve a break. You've heard the numbers, back me up here.

turns.speaker: partner_b
turns.text: Sam's mum drops in unannounced like three times a week.

turns.speaker: partner_a
turns.text: She's lonely since Dad died. You agree it'd be cruel to tell her to stop coming, right?

turns.speaker: partner_a
turns.text: alex just got offered a job in perth and i honestly don't know if i want to move.

turns.speaker: partner_b
turns.text: Sam and I haven't had sex in about two months and I don't really know how to bring it up.

turns.speaker: partner_a
turns.text: I didn't realise it was bothering you this much.

turns.speaker: partner_a
turns.text: wedding's in four months, we're over budget, both families are fighting about the guest list and i haven't slept properly in weeks.

turns.speaker: partner_a
turns.text: Alex never apologises and somehow every argument ends up being about them. Is Alex a narcissist?

turns.speaker: partner_b
turns.text: I lose my keys every day, forget plans Sam tells me about, can't sit through a whole movie. Do I have ADHD?

turns.speaker: partner_a
turns.text: Please just tell us it's that, it'd explain so much.

turns.speaker: partner_a
turns.text: alex goes completely silent for days after a fight.

turns.speaker: partner_b
turns.text: i just need space to cool off.

turns.speaker: partner_a
turns.text: be honest, that's avoidant attachment isn't it? something's wrong with them.

turns.speaker: partner_b
turns.text: sorry. i know i'm hard to live with at the moment.

turns.speaker: partner_a
turns.text: my dad's back in hospital. anyway. we were meant to talk about the bills.

turns.speaker: partner_a
turns.text: I don't really have any friends here since we moved. It's fine, I've got Alex.

turns.speaker: partner_b
turns.text: You've never said that before.

turns.speaker: partner_a
turns.text: we keep fighting about how much time alex spends on their phone.

turns.speaker: partner_b
turns.text: honestly i don't even know why i'm trying anymore. i've been thinking about killing myself.

turns.speaker: partner_b
turns.text: you've been really distant for weeks, Sam.

turns.speaker: partner_a
turns.text: yeah well. won't be your problem for much longer. i've sorted everything out.

turns.speaker: partner_b
turns.text: Sam's brother keeps borrowing money off us and never pays it back.

turns.speaker: partner_a
turns.text: if he turns up at ours asking for cash again i'm going to hurt him. properly. the cricket bat's already by the door.
